verdicts.title: Cohomology ring of tree braid groups and exterior face rings
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: For a tree $T$ and a positive integer $n$, let $B_nT$ denote the $n$-strand braid group on $T$. We use discrete Morse theory techniques to show that the cohomology ring $H^*(B_nT)$ is encoded by an explicit abstract simplicial complex $K_nT$ that measures $n$-local interactions among essential vertices of $T$. We show that, in many cases (for instance when $T$ is a binary tree), $H^*(B_nT)$ is the exterior face ring determined by $K_nT$.

verdicts.title: Trisected Rainbows and Braids
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: New explicit procedures for passing among triplane diagrams, braid movies, and braid charts for knotted surfaces in $\mathbb{R}^4$ are presented. To this end, rainbow diagrams, which lie between braid charts and triplanes, are introduced. Inequalities relating the braid index and the bridge index of 2-knots are obtained via these procedures. verdicts.title: Graph of groups decompositions of graph braid groups
